tasks.notes: trees_layer, decor_layer and ground_layer refuse --apply unless the player is within N blocks of the cell (above it, looking down); the error names the mc_player.py move command to fix it. Makes hover a checked precondition: in the retro session a hover call failed silently (output piped to tail) and the apply ran anyway. Optional ticket; drop if too speculative.

Decide and document in the skill what reapply means versus redo. Source: retro item 6.

tasks.title: Allow evidence-backed tree rooting on hard surfaces and one-block edge shunts
tasks.notes: Accepted tree shunt plan: replace lawn-only/material allowlists with evidence-led rooting, following the revised decor approach. Concrete or other hard surface alone must not reject an evidenced tree; allow lawns, gravel, paved courtyards, plazas and pavements, including unresolved small planting pits. Trunks must not root in carriageway or water; apply that check to the trunk ground footprint, not the crown centre or canopy footprint. When an evidenced trunk falls on the edge of carriageway/water, allow at most one block of adjustment onto an immediately adjacent valid rooting position. Choose deterministically, keep the canopy aligned with the observed crown as closely as possible, and record the original position, adjusted position and reason. Never chain adjustments or move farther until a tree fits. If no valid position exists within one block, leave unplaced with a review reason. Canopies may overhang carriageway, water and neighbouring cells subject to existing collision, ownership and mask rules; #218 already permits leaf-only overhang into unprepared neighbours. Preserve feature-zone protection and trunk ownership within the planting cell; do not change ground merely to legalize a tree. Align foliage rules, planners/review images and reports; add synthetic tests for legal hard ground, successful one-block edge shunt, no legal neighbour, maximum distance, deterministic choice, blocked trunk and unaffected canopy overhang. Backlog only; not implemented.
